subject: reps: RepSession changes for the one-state scope
body: Revised plan (reps/PLAN.md section 4). Please: rename emotionId to stateId; trigger.kind adds 'onboarding'; add phase (recode|test|future-pace|null); step kinds become strategy-step (with stepIndex), leverage, anchor-peak, rate (replacing physiology/focus/language); add driversSpoken[], plus the earlier asks (plannedMs, anchorPaired, recoveryCensored, signalSource, scriptHash, repIndex, profileId, startedAt/endedAt, endedBy user-stop). From the profile I need per state: ordered strategy.steps[] {modality, direction, content, submodalities}, anchorStep, fullyInAt, drivers[] ideally as {modality, attribute, peakValue, contrastValue, ratingDelta}, optional leverage, and the section-4 records.
